experience_story: Very fast-paced. 1 DSA round on Graph BFS/DFS, 1 Machine Coding round building an in-memory rate limiter, and 1 LLD round.
tips: Understand Redis rate-limiting patterns and practice graph traversals under time constraints.

experience_story: Focused on Go concurrency and channels. They asked me to explain the internal working of Kafka partitions.
tips: Practice Go channel synchronization and read about Kafka offsets and consumer groups.

experience_story: Asked tough dynamic programming problem (similar to Edit Distance) followed by high-level scaling queries.
tips: Focus on DP optimization and system design concepts like consistent hashing.

experience_story: Android mobile engineer loop. 1 round on Kotlin/Coroutines, 1 on building a simple offline database cache.
tips: Brush up Kotlin coroutine contexts, dispatchers, and Room SQLite database integration.

experience_story: 2 coding rounds (trees and arrays) and 1 behavioral round focused on Amazon Leadership Principles.
tips: Read and write STAR stories matching Amazon's 16 Leadership Principles. Practice Medium LeetCode trees.

experience_story: Standard SDE I loop. Graph Dijkstra problem and building a distributed key-value store schema design.
tips: Be strong with graph algorithms and system design basics (availability, partitioning).

experience_story: HLD round on designing a Netflix-like media delivery network. Checked edge latency and database scaling.
tips: Watch HLD playlists (caching, CDNs, database sharding). Walk through trade-offs.

experience_story: 4 coding rounds. Hard algorithms (sliding window, graph coloring). The expectations on optimization are high.
tips: Optimize time and space bounds to absolute limits. Talk through every choice out loud.

experience_story: 1 System Design round on Cloud Load Balancer, 1 Coding (hard binary search), and 1 Googlyness round.
tips: Practice explaining your thought process clearly and build solid system designs that highlight trade-offs.

experience_story: Coding round on LinkedList loops and Binary Tree serialization. System design round on Teams chat history.
tips: Be comfortable with Tree Traversals and design basic chat messaging architectures.
